digest:
- AM Best reports U.S. commercial auto underwriting performance metrics have reached their most favorable levels in decades, supporting market entry while making strict telematics underwriting vital to outperform historical averages [2].
- DoorDash agreed to acquire Instacart for $17 billion, consolidating two major on-demand delivery platforms, which could impact commercial auto insurance purchasing structures and carrier partnerships [3].
- GM agreed to pay $220 million to settle allegations of unauthorized driver behavior and location data sales, highlighting growing regulatory scrutiny on driving telemetry data collection practices relevant to our MGA [13].
- Kenco's report indicates 43% of shoppers plan to spend more during peak season expecting free two-day delivery, pointing to higher package volumes and expanded fleet utilization that increase telematics data generation [7].
